title: The Drowned Sigil Again
author: Quentin Ashgrove
blurb: Ines Sandoval, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
